# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
This batch of ~150 short call snippets is dominated by internal logistics/ops chatter (vehicle dispatch, Diwali-gift distribution runs, loading, bill-copy exchanges, "boss/field staff" coordination). Genuine **sales** content is present but scattered across roughly 35–40 calls — mostly short, transactional enquiry calls (rate checks, quotation requests, dealer price negotiation, order-size corrections) rather than long consultative pitches. Because the real sales signal is thin and repetitive, this KB stays close to what is actually said rather than extrapolating a full playbook. Crayon Roofing & Structures operates out of Manali / Andarkuppam check-post, Chennai, and sells **metal roofing sheets and related structural/fastening accessories**, not just "roofing" in the generic sense — screws, welding rods, polycarbonate sheets, and PUFF panels all appear as real line items in these calls.

## Products & brand ladder
Based only on what sales calls actually quote:

- **Metal roofing sheets (color-coated, profile/corrugated)** — core product.
  - **JSW "Color on Plus"** — premium tier, thickness options 0.47 mm, 0.50 mm, 0.6 mm quoted repeatedly. Colors mentioned: sky blue, royal blue, half-white/off-white, grey.
  - **JSW Pragathi / Pragati** — a step tier, quoted separately from Color on Plus.
  - **JSW Radiance / Silver-on-Plus** — another JSW sub-brand, slightly different pricing bracket ("Silver-on கொஞ்சம் விலை அதிகம், JSW Steel கொஞ்சம் விலை கம்மி").
  - **Asian / "Indira Dhanush" (AZ 70 GSM, ISI marked)** — lower-cost alternative, explicitly contrasted with JSW: "வெறும் Indra Dhanush AZ70GSM ISI symbol இருக்கும்."
  - Thickness range sold: 0.45 mm (entry/"bazaar" grade), 0.47 mm, 0.50 mm, 0.6 mm, 0.7 mm requested but **not stocked** ("0.7 mm-ல இல்ல Sir, 0.6 mm-ல sky blue available").
- **Profile/tile-profile sheets** — a separate factory handles this; agents quote but defer ("நம்மளோட இன்னொரு factory-ல tile profile sheet-ஓட இது இருக்கு").
- **PUFF insulated panels (wall + roof)** — 50 mm/40 mm/30 mm thickness, quoted ~₹1650 + GST per sq meter; agents are explicit this needs factory confirmation on warranty/claim terms.
- **Polycarbonate / Lexan sheets** — clear/transparent, thickness 1.5 mm, 1.8 mm, 2 mm, and 10 mm; max standard length is **15 feet** ("Polycarbonate-ஐ பொறுத்தவரைக்கும் 15 அடி தான் standard").
- **Accessories**: L-flash, ridge, gutter, cutter/crimp pieces — all custom-diagram driven; agents repeatedly ask for separate width/height diagrams rather than one combined sketch.
- **Fasteners**: Tata Agri self-drilling screws (various sizes: 1 inch, 2 inch, 25 mm, 55 mm, M8), rust-free variants.
- **Welding rods** (Tata brand) — sold by carton/box with scheme-based volume discounts.
- **MS channels (JSW brand, 125×65)** — mentioned once, routed to a colleague for details.
- **GI sheet / UPVC sheet** — customers ask, but company does **not** stock these ("UPVC நம்மகிட்ட available இல்லை", "GI sheet last time குடுக்கல, நம்ம metal roofing sheet தான் supply பண்ணிருக்கோம்").
- Not roofing-only: screws, welding rods, and polycarbonate are real independent SKUs with their own customers and pricing — train staff to not default every call to "roofing sheet."

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)
- JSW Color on Plus 0.47 mm: **₹420 + GST / sq.m** (one call) and **₹445 + GST / sq.m** (other calls, including Pragathi 0.47).
- Pragathi/"Pragati" color on plus: **₹445 + GST / sq.m**; another instance **₹410 + GST / sq.m**.
- Asian Indira Dhanush 0.45 mm: **₹370 + GST / sq.m**; profile coil **₹101 + tax**, with a ₹3 reduction quoted as ₹98/₹97.
- Kg-based sheet pricing: **₹118–₹120 + GST per kg** (customers sometimes ask kg vs sq.m — agents must clarify which unit applies; running-meter weight ≈ 4 kg/sq.m for 0.47 mm stock).
- 10 ft Asian Indradhanush sheet: **₹1251 + 18% GST** (plus loading charge).
- 10 ft JSW sheet: **₹1466 + 18% GST**.
- Polycarbonate 2 mm: **₹800 + GST / sq.m**; 10 mm clear: **₹61 + tax / sq.ft**.
- PUFF 50 mm panel: **~₹1650 + GST / sq.m** (works out to ~₹2000 with GST, agent notes "அது இப்ப சாதா sheet இல்லல்ல").
- Cutter/L-flash accessory: standard width **610 mm = ₹655**; going beyond 610 mm width **doubles the rate** since it consumes a full sheet.
